get_unread_emails.rationale: Email retrieval may expose external content; also marks messages as read.

get_sent_emails.rationale: Stored email text is external context, including earlier generated or forwarded content.

get_received_emails.rationale: Received email may contain third-party content.

get_draft_emails.rationale: Stored drafts are external context rather than current user instructions.

search_emails.rationale: Search results may expose external email content.

search_contacts_by_name.rationale: Stored contact records enter as external tool data.

search_contacts_by_email.rationale: Stored contact records enter as external tool data.

search_calendar_events.rationale: Calendar entries may contain external titles, descriptions, and participant data.

get_day_calendar_events.rationale: Calendar entries enter as external context.

search_files_by_filename.rationale: Retrieved file text may include third-party content.

get_file_by_id.rationale: Retrieved file text is external data.

list_files.rationale: Listed file records enter as external data.

search_files.rationale: Retrieved file records may expose third-party content.

send_email.rationale: Sends simulated email, potentially including recipients and attachments.

get_unread_emails.rationale: Marks retrieved messages as read; this source is also a state-changing zero-argument sink.

create_calendar_event.rationale: Creates a calendar entry and sends simulated invitations.

cancel_calendar_event.rationale: Cancels a calendar entry and sends simulated notifications.

reschedule_calendar_event.rationale: Changes calendar times and sends simulated notifications.

add_calendar_event_participants.rationale: Changes participants and sends simulated notifications.

get_current_day.rationale: Returns the simulator clock; excluded from this external-content source mapping.
